༄༅/ /'od gsal sbyong ba'i gnad yig bdud rtsi rgyal po bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'od gsal sbyong ba'i gnad yig bdud rtsi

rgyal po bzhugs so/ / chos mchog rgya mtsho zab mo yi/ /mdzod brnyes gang la phyag 'tshal te/ / bla ma rdo rje snying po yi/ /spyod mchog bdud rtsi rgyal po bri/ /nags tshal mtsho gling dur khrod dang*/ /lha khang phyugs lhas grong khyer dang*/ /khang stong shing gcig chu ngogs 'gram/ /'jigs dang dga' dang mya ngan gnas/ /sems g.yeng byed der rab song la/ /bde ba'i stan la rab 'dug ste/ /skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed nas/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang*/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /'gro drug lan chags gnod byed 'dre/ /thams cad bsam la rang gi lus/ /sha khrag 'dod yon longs spyod du/ /gang la gang 'dod chags med sbyin/ /de rjes gang yang mi bsam par/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang du nyal/ /de tshe rang gi rnam rtog dang*/ /'khrul snang lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ni/ /dngos dang nyams snang rmi lam du/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de tshe gnad kyi gdams ngag la/ /rgyu mtshan brtags pas shes pa dang*/ /rang bzhin snyems bral glaud pa'o/ /dang po rgyu mtshan brtag pa ni/ / cho 'phrul gang snang dpe mtshon pa/ /snang srid snod bcud thams cad kyi/ / gzugs su snang ba ngo bos stong*/ /cha shas med cing rang bzhin bral/ /sgyu ma rmi lam chu zla bzhin/ /ma skyes pas na gnas pa med/ /'gags med 'gro 'ong kun las 'das/ /de la 'jigs pa ci zhig yin/ /sgra ni grags pa nyid nas stong*/ /dri ro reg dang chos kun yang*/ /ngo bos stong ste gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /med snang stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /'jigs dang dga' ba ci zhig bya/ /'jigs pa'i yul la brtags dpyad pas/ /rang bzhin med pa ji lta bar/ /'jigs mkhan sems la tshur bltas pas/ /sems ni dus gsum gzhi rtsa bral/ /brtag pas ma rnyed rgyu mtshan bral/ kha dog dbyibs med ngos gzung bral/ /gang zhig gang gis dga' 'jigs skyed/ /de ltar yul sems gzung 'dzin du/ /med pa de tshe chos rnams kun/

/nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas/ /gzhan du 'dzin pa ngang gis stong*/ /de nyid rang byung ye shes te/ / rang gsal spros dang bral bar gzhag /gnyis pa rang zhir glod pa ni/ brtags dang ma brtags gang tshe yang*/ /rang bzhin med de gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /de la dran bsam dgos pa med/ /gang snang steng du gang shar glod/ / snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun/ /snang na chos nyid stong par snang*/ / stong na srid gsum 'khor ba stong*/ /rtag na chos sku 'gyur ba med/ /chad na las dang nyon mongs chad/ /des na gang snang mi snang med/ /legs nyes shor god 'ga' med pas/ /gzhi bral mnyam pa'i ngang du nyal/ /lha 'drer snang yang ngos gzung med/ /de la gzugs med 'jigs med dgos/ /'jigs mkhan sems yin ngos gzung med/ /de la bden med spang mi dgos/ /de ltar yul sems dga' 'jigs dang*/ /dug lnga'i rnam rtog thams cad la/ / cer mthong rang sangs ngos gzung la/ /snyems med ngang du glod par bya/ /de nas gnyan sar gnyis 'dzin zhig /re dogs bral ba'i tshar tshad thog / zhar la thun mongs dngos grub ni/ /lha 'dre dam thogs stong grogs byed/ / rkyen rnams thugs phrad rang grol yin/ /de phyir gnad 'di nyams su longs/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun/ /skye med klong du grol bar shog /'od gsal spyod pa'i gnad yig / bdud rtsi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)'od gsal sbyong ba'i gnad yig bdud rtsi rgyal po/ - PAGE 112 -- PAGE 111 - - PAGE 110 -
